narr: Thunderstorms developed ahead of a developing low pressure along a stationary front on July 16th. These thunderstorms quickly dropped 1-2 inches of rain in less than an hour resulting in localized flash flooding.
ev: Flooding on NJ 17 both directions north of NJ 120/Paterson Plank Road. Two out of three right lanes closed southbound. All northbound lanes closed.
lsr: FLOODING ON NJ 17 BOTH DIRECTIONS NORTH OF NJ 120/PATERSON PLANK ROAD (CARLSTADT). TWO OUT OF THREE RIGHT LANES CLOSED SOUTHBOUND. ALL LANES CLOSED NORTHBOUND.
